# Fixtures from Tanvi's layout maker

Copied from `examples/` in [Tanvi-15/Layout-maker](https://github.com/Tanvi-15/Layout-maker) by
Tanvi Deshpande: for each test video, her timeline, schematic layout, Depth Anything 3 measurements
and fused layout. `apartment1` is the same video as FitSplit's bundled demo job, and its
`layout_fused.json` is the reference the layout engines are scored against. Her repo has no license
file yet; Aatmaj is confirming with her.
